title: TRUSTMH-BENCH: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating the Trustworthiness of Large Language Models in Mental Health
measurement_description: Performance variance in emotional support tasks across different religious groups (Christianity, Islam, Buddhism), evaluating the consistency of LLM performance.
base_benchmarks: Digital Health Ethics (Organization, 2024; Floridi et al., 2018)
WHO Guidance on Ethics and Governance of AI for Health
findings: General-purpose models like GPT-5.1 and Claude-Sonnet-4.5 demonstrated relatively low range and standard deviation across most demographic categories, including religion, indicating stable and balanced performance. Some specialized models, such as PsycoLLM and MentalLLaMA, showed significantly higher range and standard deviation, reflecting greater instability in the fairness of their outputs across demographics including religion.
